cohort: The study included 276 neonates aged 0 to 28 days admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Soroti Region Referral Hospital in Uganda.
finding: Neonatal sepsis was significantly associated with an Apgar Score < 7, having a breech delivery, Premature rupture of membranes, Intrapartum infection, foul-smelling amniotic fluid, undergoing invasive procedures, prolonged labour > 8 hours, and febrile illness during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Breech presentation was identified as a significant risk factor for neonatal sepsis (aPR = 1.79, 95%CI; 1.26-2.53, P = 0.001).
cross-section timing: Data was collected for neonates aged 0-28 days admitted to the NICU.
